Profesorii de legislație rutieră efectue: Road traffic legislation teachers provide theoretical training for people seeking a driving licence. They may carry out this activity only if certified by the Ministry of Transport, Infrastructure and Communications through the Romanian Road Authority (A.R.R.), in accordance with the rules on certification of road traffic legislation teachers and driving instructors approved by Ministerial Order (OMT) No. 733/2013.
Atestarea ca profesor de legislație ruti: Certification as a road traffic legislation teacher involves the following steps:
Perioada de valabilitate a atestatului d: The road traffic legislation teacher certificate is valid for five years from passing the examination.
Pot avea acces la pregătirea și atestare: People who have graduated from an accredited long-cycle higher education institution in legal or technical sciences may access professional training and certification as road traffic legislation teachers.
Pe lângă condiția de studii, solicitantu: In addition to the educational requirement, applicants must meet all the following conditions:
a) să aibă vârsta de cel puțin 25 de ani: a) be at least 25 years old;
b) să dețină permis de conducere valabil: b) hold a valid driving licence for at least category B, held for at least five years;
c) să nu fi avut suspendată exercitarea: c) not have had their right to drive suspended for alcohol consumption in the past year or more than twice in the past 15 years;
d) să nu fi avut anulat permisul de cond: d) not have had their driving licence revoked in the past 10 years;
e) să fie aptă din punct de vedere medic: e) be medically and psychologically fit to carry out the activity;
f) să nu fi fost condamnată printr-o hot: f) not have been convicted by a final court judgment of a road traffic offence, murder, assault or injury causing death, serious bodily injury, robbery, assault on a public official, offences against public decency, disturbing public order, rape, unlawful deprivation of liberty, receiving or giving bribes, influence peddling, drug trafficking or unlawful drug use, unless rehabilitation or amnesty has occurred;
Actele necesare pentru înscrierea la cur: The following documents required to enrol on a road traffic legislation teacher certification course must be submitted to a road transport personnel training and professional development centre authorised by the Ministry of Transport, Infrastructure and Communications:
b) actul de identitate, în copie;: b) a copy of the identity document;
c) permisul de conducere, în copie;: c) a copy of the driving licence;
d) actul de studii, în copie legalizată;: d) a certified copy of the educational qualification;
e) cazier auto sau alt document echivale: e) the original driving record or equivalent document, valid for 30 days, showing compliance with Article 7(1)(c) and (d) of the rules on certification of road traffic legislation teachers and driving instructors approved by OMT No. 733/2013, as subsequently amended; or, for citizens of other EU Member States, a notarised declaration confirming that their licence has not been revoked or suspended for the reasons specified in Article 7 of those rules;
f) aviz medical și psihologic valabile,: f) original, valid medical and psychological reports stating “fit” for work as a road traffic legislation teacher;
g) certificatul de cazier judiciar, în o: g) the original criminal record certificate showing compliance with Article 7(1)(f) of the above rules;
Actele prevăzute la lit. b) și c) și f): The documents referred to in points (b), (c) and (f) must be checked against the originals and certified as true copies by the person receiving them at the road transport personnel training and professional development centre, with the wording “true to the original”, their full name and signature.
La examenul pentru obținerea/reînnoirea: Only candidates who meet the course enrolment requirements and have completed the professional training or development course may take the examination to obtain or renew a road traffic legislation teacher certificate.
Persoanele declarate respinse la examenu: Candidates who fail the examination for a road traffic legislation teacher certificate may retake it within one year of their initial examination.
Candidates who fail the examination to renew a road traffic legislation teacher certificate may retake it within one year of their initial examination, but before their current certificate expires.
În cazul atestării, candidatul are drept: For initial certification, candidates are entitled to a maximum of two retakes within 12 months of the initial examination.
În cazul reînnoirii atestatului, candida: For certificate renewal, candidates are entitled to a maximum of two retakes within 12 months of the initial examination, but before their current certificate expires.
Examenul pentru obținerea atestatului de: The examination for a road traffic legislation teacher certificate consists of the following tests:
a) probă scrisă, eliminatorie, care are: a) an eliminatory written test assessing knowledge of road traffic rules and vehicles, consisting of 60 multiple-choice questions to be answered in 60 minutes; this test is computer-based;
b) probă orală pentru evaluarea capacită: b) an oral test assessing teaching and educational psychology skills, consisting of a presentation on road traffic legislation and defensive driving lasting at least 15 minutes.
Pentru promovarea examenului, candidatul: To pass, candidates must answer at least 54 multiple-choice questions correctly and pass the oral test with a grade of at least 7.
Examenul pentru reînnoirea atestatului d: The renewal examination for a road traffic legislation teacher certificate consists of the test in point (a). Candidates must answer at least 54 multiple-choice questions correctly to pass.
Întrebările din testul grilă au patru va: Each multiple-choice question has four possible answers; one, two, three, all four or none may be correct.
La finalizarea testului - grilă, punctaj: At the end of the multiple-choice test, each candidate's score and pass/fail result are automatically displayed on the computer used for the examination.
După finalizarea cursului de pregătire p: After completing professional training, candidates may take the examination only in the county or municipality of Bucharest where the authorised centre that trained them is based.
Candidații respinși la primul examen pot: Candidates who fail their first examination may retake it in any county or in Bucharest.
Examinarea în vederea atestării profesio: Professional certification examinations for specialist road transport personnel are organised and conducted only for candidates registered in the examination computer system by authorised centres, which certify completion of professional training in accordance with the regulations in force.
Pentru fiecare sesiune de examinare prev: For each session in the examination calendar, the examination committee schedules candidates according to their examination specialisations and then alphabetically by surname. The Romanian Road Authority (A.R.R.) informs the relevant training centres of the schedule at least 48 hours before the examinations and also publishes it at www.arr.ro.
Membrii comisiei de examinare interzic a: The examination committee refuses entry to candidates under the influence of alcohol or psychotropic substances and to anyone who is not a candidate, except technical staff addressing an electronic equipment fault.
Membrii comisiei de examinare alocă fiec: Using the computer system, the examination committee assigns each eligible candidate a unique numerical examination code that provides access to the multiple-choice questionnaire generated by the examination application. Candidates receive the code when entering the examination room.
În momentul accesului în sala de examen,: On entering the examination room, candidates must enter their full name, personal identification number and handwritten signature on the register provided by the examination committee.
După înregistrare în tabel, candidații s: After signing the register, candidates are directed to the computer where they will complete the multiple-choice questionnaire. They access the computer-assisted examination system using the unique code received from the examination committee.
Punctajele obținute de către candidați l: At the end of the test, candidates' scores for the multiple-choice questions generated by the examination system are automatically displayed on their computer, together with their Pass/Fail result for that test.
Candidații care au obținut calificativul: Candidates who pass the multiple-choice test may take the oral examination. They receive examination sheets or forms signed by a committee member and a task requiring them to prepare and present a lesson plan on a road traffic legislation topic.
Membrii comisiei de examinare întrerup e: The examination committee stops the examination of candidates who:
- folosesc în sala de examinare înscrisu: - use unauthorised notes, communication or audio/video recording equipment, or any objects or equipment that could be used to cheat in the examination room;
- poartă discuții cu alți candidați, se: - talk to other candidates, behave noisily or otherwise disrupt other candidates, or are not appropriately dressed;
- se prezintă la examen sub influența bă: - attend the examination under the influence of alcohol or psychotropic substances.
Instructorul de conducere auto efectueaz: Driving instructors provide practical training for people seeking a driving licence. They may carry out this activity only if certified by the Ministry of Transport, Infrastructure and Communications through the Romanian Road Authority (A.R.R.), in accordance with the rules on certification of road traffic legislation teachers and driving instructors approved by OMT No. 733/2013.
Atestarea inițială ca instructor de cond: Initial certification as a driving instructor involves the following steps:
Perioada de valabilitate a atestatului d: The driving instructor certificate is valid for five years from passing the practical certification examination.
Extinderea valabilității atestatului de: Extending a driving instructor certificate involves the following steps:
- urmarea unui curs de perfecționare pro: - completing a professional development course during the final year of validity of the current certificate;
- promovarea examenului pentru reînnoire: - passing the renewal examination before the current certificate expires.
În cazul extinderii valabilității cu cat: When additional categories are added to a driving instructor certificate, a new certificate is issued, valid from the date the practical examination is passed until the expiry date of the previous certificate.
Obținerea atestatului de instructor auto: Driving instructor certification is initially obtained for one or more of categories A, B or BE. After at least two years of actual work as a driving instructor, certification may also be obtained for categories C, CE, Tr, Tv or Tb. The actual work referred to in paragraph (2) consists of training at least 100 driving licence applicants during that period.

Certification as a driving instructor for category D or DE requires holding instructor certification for at least category C or CE for a minimum of two years, during which the applicant must have completed the training of at least 30 trainees for those categories.
Reînnoirea atestatului de instructor de: Renewing a driving instructor certificate involves the following steps:

Fiecare conducător auto trebuie să fie c: Every driver should recognise that defensive driving is an important part of civilised road use. It brings immediate and significant benefits, such as fuel savings. It improves your vehicle's efficiency, helps avoid repair visits and saves money. Respecting speed limits also gives you time to take the necessary action when a difficult traffic situation arises, helping you avoid an accident. Above all, defensive driving means showing respect for other road users.
Iată câteva dintre măsurile pe care treb: Here are some steps you can take to practise defensive driving:
Pregătiți dinainte itinerarul pe care îI: Prepare your route in advance to make your journey more efficient. Do your best to avoid heavy traffic, roadworks and rough terrain to save time and fuel.
Utilizarea sistemului de climatizare al: Using your vehicle's air conditioning in city traffic can increase petrol consumption by 20%. Consider opening the windows instead and saving air conditioning for motorway driving, where open windows can affect the vehicle's aerodynamics.
Verificați presiunea pneurilor o dată pe: Check tyre pressures once a month when the tyres are cold, meaning the vehicle has not been driven for more than two hours. To find the correct pressure, do not rely on the markings on the tyre itself, which indicate the maximum pressure. Consult your vehicle manufacturer's manual instead. Rotate the tyres every 10,000 km and have wheel alignment and balancing carried out once a year.
Asigurați-vă că faceți verificarea mașin: Make sure your vehicle is checked regularly
Verificați periodic nivelul uleiului din: Regularly check engine oil, coolant, brake fluid, power steering fluid and windscreen washer fluid levels. Always take the necessary steps to keep your vehicle roadworthy. This helps avoid unexpected repairs and expenses while saving fuel and reducing emissions.
